title: dryopteris beddomei
intro: Dryopteris beddomei, commonly known as Beddome's shield fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is native to India and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The health benefits of Dryopteris beddomei include its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its therapeutic actions of being an expectorant and anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
